type_legend.unsafe_inference: A specific inference the counselor/scoring logic must never make
type_legend.scoring_hint: A directional suggestion for how existing or future scoring logic should weight something — not a specific formula
type_legend.data_gap: A concrete, currently-missing schema/field this research identified
type_legend.interpretation: How a fact should be read/presented to be honest about what it does and doesn't establish

rules.statement: Do not treat activities.organization_scope free text as a confirmed founder-vs-joined fact — it is an unverified proxy, and founding is evidence for both leadership and entrepreneurship at once.
Titles ('captain', 'president', 'founder') are near-zero evidence alone, generalizing lib/scoring/dimensions/leadership.ts's existing title-discount pattern to every dimension a role touches.
hours_per_week × weeks_per_year is an unbounded self-reported estimate — treat as a coarse ordering signal, never display as a computed precise total-hours figure.

No field captures grade level at time of activity; deriving it from start_date + graduation_year is an unsafe inference across curricula with different grade/age mappings (US/UK/Turkey differ) unless that mapping is explicitly encoded, which it is not today.
A populated URL field (repo_url/live_url/output_url) proves an artifact exists and is checkable, not that it is good, used, or well-received.
Free-text outcome_summary impact claims ('reached thousands of users') are claims, not verified outcomes, regardless of evidence_status.
verification_rejected must never be treated the same as self_reported downstream — a failed verification attempt is a negative signal, not an absence of one.

Never imply who confirmed an evidence_added record — the shipped schema does not capture verifier identity/type; a proposed additive verifier_type field is described but not implemented by this research.
The six commitment-axis levels (exposure...creation) are not summable into one cross-profile score — reads must stay per-activity.
Never numerically compare/combine grades across different grading scales without an explicit normalization step; absent metadata, the comparison is unknown, not an average.
A course record with no grade is missing data, not a zero.
A student_interests row with no linked activity/project/research evidence must never by itself raise this dimension's score — it is a stated preference.

Protects existing correct behavior: lib/scoring/dimensions/leadership.ts's small capped title-bonus should not be increased in future edits — that would regress the mission's 'no leadership from title alone' requirement.
Founding status cannot be reliably recovered from organization_scope free text today — infer at confidence no higher than low until a structured role field exists.
Read independence_level as a genuine strength gate, not decorative text — 'shadowed' and 'designed and ran independently' are different tiers even with identical duration/hours.
output_type = 'none' is not automatically weaker than a row with output — independence and methodology matter at least as much as output presence.
A project with none of live_url/repo_url/users_reached/revenue_amount populated is a plan, not executed entrepreneurship, regardless of description language.
revenue_amount and users_reached corroborate that execution happened; they are not magnitudes to rank profiles by.
Never rank students by raw summed volunteering hours alone — hours concentrated in one cause_area is a stronger signal than the same total spread across unrelated one-off events.
Beneficiary/'people served' counts are self-reported estimates regardless of evidence_status; never present without that qualifier.
An award's strength depends on selectivity/scope and result-tier as independent facts — 'national award' with unspecified scope reads at medium, not high, confidence.
An awards row with no discoverable link to an originating activity is lower-context and should read one confidence tier below an equivalent linked award.
A career_goals row with no plausibly-connected activity/project/work experience/opportunity is a stated intention, not demonstrated exploration — its age must never imply progress.
Count distinct sustained explorations, not total career-exposure event attendance — several one-day events don't sum to one focused, sustained exploration.
ongoing=true with no end_date, no output, and no recent updated_at movement should be read as stale, not actively strong — no specific decay function computed by this research.
A complexity/impact claim in free-text description carries materially less weight than the same claim with a corroborating URL — description is a claim about evidence, not evidence.
Never model recognition as one flat list mixing result-tier, output-type, and role together (the mission brief's own example list does this) — keep the three (plus scope) as independent axes.
registered tier must never feed any ProfileDimension score above a negligible floor — it demonstrates intent, not development.

Core proposed fix: awards_distinction should only activate at advanced/qualified result tier or above; below that, credit only the category's participation-level dimensions. Directly closes the gap where entering and winning a competition produce identical CATEGORY_DIMENSIONS output today.
Do not assign a specific numeric scope multiplier in this research — scope is a qualitative modifier on result tier, never merged into one combined prestige score.
An award with scope=unknown should read one confidence tier below an otherwise-identical record with known scope.

A summer program that culminates in a publication should not have its own attendance credit inflated by the publication — model as two linked facts (program participation + research output), not one merged one.
Selectivity-at-entry (most fellowships) and selectivity-at-result (most competitions) are different mechanisms and must not share one gating rule.

rules.statement: Breadth dimensions (intellectual_curiosity, career_exploration — code-verified to skip diminishing-returns aggregation) and depth dimensions (the other 7) serve different developmental purposes; a counselor must be able to recommend a breadth/exploratory action without treating it as inherently lower-value than a depth action.

rules.statement: Field/major alignment (already implemented as fieldAlignment/relevanceScore in lib/counselor/config.ts and lib/opportunities/matching.ts) is a relevance axis, not a development dimension — never conflate 'how strong is this evidence' with 'how well does it match stated interests.'
